item.title: Frood, an Alpine Initramfs NAS
item.description:
📝 It’s just one big initramfs containing a whole Alpine Linux system. It’s a simple cpio archive of the files that make up the very first root filesystem at boot. conf" export ALPINE_BRANCH=edge export SCRIPT_CHROOT=yes export FS_SKEL_DIR=root export FS_SKEL_CHOWN=root:root PACKAGES="$(cat packages)" export PACKAGES.

item.title: Databricks Launches LTAP: A Unified OLAP/OLTP Data Architecture
item.description:
📝 Databricks Launches LTAP: The First Lake Transactional/Analytical Processing ArchitectureJune 16, 2026Databricks today launched LTAP (Lake Transactional/Analytical Processing), a new data processing architecture that unifies OLAP and OLTP on a single copy of data in the lake, eliminating ETL, replicas, and pipelines by design. DATA + AI SUMMIT – June 16, 2026 – Databricks, the Data and AI company, today introduced Lake Transactional/Analytical Processing (LTAP), a new data processing architecture that unifies transactions, analytics, streaming, and operational data on a single copy of storage in the lake. Lakebase stores data directly in Unity Catalog, using the same open formats as the Lakehouse.
🔗 Read more: https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-ltap-first-lake-transactionalanalytical
